title: bloomcrafts
description: Bloomcrafts is a free, family-friendly Minecraft server featuring the Create mod — join us for enhanced building, automation, and survival gameplay with easy one-click modpack installation.
body:
Bloomcrafts is a free Minecraft server built around the Create mod, offering a family-friendly experience with enhanced building, automation, and survival gameplay. 

Our server is completely free to join — we handle all the technical hosting so you can focus on building, exploring, and creating mechanical contraptions. With one-click modpack installation, you can be in-game within minutes, no server configuration or technical knowledge required. Our moderated community provides a safe, grief-protected environment where players of all ages can collaborate on towns, farms, and creative projects together. Whether you're a Redstone engineer, a landscape architect, or just looking for a welcoming place to play, Bloomcrafts is your home in the blocky world.
